displayName: EACQ-FV-R0 RAG retriever owner source verification
priorAbsorption: The retriever and its focused tests are existing CVF runtime owner surfaces. EACQ-FV-R0 used them only to verify ownership and candidate seam shape; it did not modify or execute them.

findings.summary: The original roadmap omitted the existing RAG retriever owner while proposing a future retrieval-evaluation seam.
findings.nextAction: The revised roadmap now cites the current owner and keeps UAA implementation closed behind its conjunctive reopen gates.

negativeSearchTerms: conditional reopen index enforcement checker for the EACQ-FV rule - repository checker search returned no current EACQ-FV-specific enforcement
nextScanRecommendation: Re-scan only after operator approval opens a bounded UAA seam-verification work order or the retriever owner path/symbol changes.
